outboxer.name: Out-boxer
outboxer.desc: Stays long behind a stiff jab and keeps moving. Hard to reach, rarely trades.

swarmer.name: Swarmer
swarmer.desc: Walks you down and never stops throwing. Lives on the inside with hooks.

slugger.name: Slugger
slugger.desc: Slow feet, heavy hands. Waits for one big hook or uppercut to end it.

counter.name: Counter-puncher
counter.desc: Lets you lead, slips or blocks, then fires back before you reset.

body.name: Body snatcher
body.desc: Digs to the ribs and the liver round after round until your legs go.

slick.name: Slick defender
slick.desc: Slips, ducks and rolls everything, then pecks at you from odd angles.

volume.name: Volume puncher
volume.desc: Fast, light punches in long bunches. Wins rounds on work rate.

shell.name: Shell guard
shell.desc: Hides behind a high guard, takes your best shots on the arms, then breaks yours.

showman.name: Showman
showman.desc: Flashy and loud. Throws in flurries, taunts when ahead, can be caught showing off.
